# Sceneform-EQR

> Sceneform-EQR is an Android-native 3D/XR renderer extended from Google Sceneform and powered by Filament. This file is a source-oriented guide for LLMs and coding agents. It indexes the current EQR public APIs, the runnable sample code, and the tutorial implementation patterns in this repository.

Treat Java/Kotlin/C++ source and Gradle files as authoritative when this file and generated Javadoc differ.

## Canonical project facts

- Current EQR source/publishing version: `1.2.1`.
- Filament runtime: `1.75.0`.
- Android configuration: min SDK 24, compile SDK 34, target SDK 34.
- Build configuration: JDK 17, Gradle 8.5, Android Gradle Plugin 8.1.0, Java/JVM target 1.8.
- Native build configuration: NDK `27.3.13750724`, CMake `3.22.1`.
- Enabled ABI in the current library and sample: `arm64-v8a`.
- Optional XR runtimes used by the sample: ARCore `1.45.0`, Huawei AREngine `4.0.0.5`.
- The `main` branch is Apache-2.0 and does not contain eq-slam. ORB-SLAM3/eq-slam code belongs to the GPLv3 branch.
- The main implementation language is Java. The renderer also contains Kotlin and C++/JNI code.

## Primary documentation

- [English README](README.md): project capabilities, setup, examples, lifecycle rules, and license.
- [中文 README](README_CN.md): 中文项目介绍、接入方式、示例和生命周期约束。
- [Generated Javadoc](doc/javadoc/index.html): generated Sceneform/EQR API reference; it can lag behind current source.
- [Sample catalog](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/SampleCatalog.java): authoritative list of common samples and tutorial lessons.
- [Fragment factory](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/SampleFragmentFactory.java): lesson id to Fragment mapping.
- [Library Gradle configuration](Eq-Renderer/Android/eq-renderer/build.gradle): library version, ABI, Native build, and publication settings.
- [Sample Gradle configuration](SampleProj/app/build.gradle): application dependencies and optional AR runtimes.

## Repository map

- `Eq-Renderer/Android/eq-renderer`: EQR Android library, Sceneform fork/extensions, Filament Java/native libraries, JNI loaders, materials, IBL, and skybox assets.
- `SampleProj/app`: runnable application, common samples, structured tutorials, GLB/PLY/video assets, and UI resources.
- `Tool`: Windows Filament tools (`matc`, `cmgen`, `gltf_viewer`, `resgen`), source `.mat` files, IBL source assets, and `genfilamat-mobile.bat`.
- `doc/javadoc`: generated API documentation.
- `doc/img`: README preview images.

Keep library implementations in `Eq-Renderer`, demonstrations in `SampleProj`, and material source/build inputs in `Tool`.

## Build and dependency setup

Open `SampleProj` in Android Studio or build on Windows:

```powershell
cd SampleProj
.\gradlew.bat assembleDebug
```

The sample includes the library as a local Gradle module:

```groovy
implementation project(path: ':eq-renderer')
```

The library source declares Maven coordinates `com.eqgis:eq-renderer:1.2.1`. The configured repository is:

```groovy
maven {
    allowInsecureProtocol = true
    url "http://repo.eqgis.cn"
}
```

When using AR, the application must add its selected runtime because the library declares ARCore and AREngine as `compileOnly`:

```groovy
implementation "com.google.ar:core:1.45.0"
// Or, when Huawei AREngine is required:
implementation "com.huawei.hms:arenginesdk:4.0.0.5"
```

## Runtime architecture and lifecycle

### Scene ownership

- `SceneLayout` owns one `SceneView` and one `RootNode` tree.
- `ARSceneLayout` extends `SceneLayout` and additionally owns an AR session, AR configuration, plane renderer, and plane-tap helper.
- A `Node` references a `RenderableInstance`; the renderable/material may share Filament resources with other nodes or scenes.
- Scene-local resources must be detached before the scene is destroyed. Engine-wide shared resources are reclaimed only after the final active `SceneView` exits.
- Do not call `Renderer.destroyAllResources()` or `SceneView.destroyAllResources()` from an individual Fragment or tab switch.

### Required host lifecycle

```java
private SceneLayout sceneLayout;

@Override
protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
    super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
    setContentView(R.layout.your_scene);
    sceneLayout = findViewById(R.id.scene_layout);
    sceneLayout.init(this);
    sceneLayout.addIndirectLight("enviroments/light/lightroom_ibl.ktx", 50);
}

@Override
protected void onResume() {
    super.onResume();
    sceneLayout.resume();
}

@Override
protected void onPause() {
    sceneLayout.pause();
    super.onPause();
}

@Override
protected void onDestroy() {
    sceneLayout.destroy();
    super.onDestroy();
}
```

Fragment tutorials implement the same order in [BaseSampleFragment](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/BaseSampleFragment.java): pause the scene, remove the layout from its parent, let the lesson detach its resources, destroy the sample scene, then call `SceneLayout.destroy()`.

### Safe async pattern

Every asynchronous model/material callback must verify that its host and request are still current before attaching a resource:

```java
final int generation = requestGeneration;
ModelRenderable.builder()
        .setSource(requireContext(), Uri.parse("gltf/Fox.glb"), true)
        .setIsFilamentGltf(true)
        .build()
        .thenAccept(renderable -> {
            if (!isSceneActive() || generation != requestGeneration) {
                return;
            }
            Node node = new Node();
            node.setRenderable(renderable);
            node.setParent(sceneLayout.getRootNode());
        });
```

On destruction, invalidate the request generation and cancel/remove delayed tasks where possible. Never attach a late result to a destroyed Fragment scene.

## Core EQR API index

### Core status

Source: [Eqr.java](Eq-Renderer/Android/eq-renderer/src/main/java/com/eqgis/eqr/core/Eqr.java)

- `Eqr.getCoreVersion()` returns the EQR native core version.
- `Eqr.getFilamentVersion()` returns the native Filament version.
- `Eqr.getCoreStatus()` validates the native core.
- Loading `Eqr` loads native library `eqr-core`.

### SceneLayout

Source: [SceneLayout.java](Eq-Renderer/Android/eq-renderer/src/main/java/com/eqgis/eqr/layout/SceneLayout.java)

Important methods:

- `SceneLayout init(Context context)` creates the selected SceneView and RootNode.
- `SceneLayout setSceneViewType(SceneViewType type)` must be called before `init` for non-default views.
- `SceneView getSceneView()`, `Camera getCamera()`, `RootNode getRootNode()` expose the scene primitives.
- `void resume()`, `void pause()`, `void destroy()` forward and release lifecycle state.
- `void removeNode(Node node)` recursively detaches a scene-owned subtree but preserves `RootNode` itself.
- `void addDefaultIndirectLight()` loads the bundled default IBL.
- `void addIndirectLight(String assetsFilePath, int intensity)` loads a KTX IBL from assets.
- `void setIndirectLight(IndirectLight light)`, `IndirectLight getIndirectLight()` manage IBL.
- `void setSkybox(String assetsPath)`, `void setSkybox(Skybox skybox)`, `Skybox getSkybox()` manage the skybox.
- `void setTransparent(boolean transparent)` controls background transparency.
- `Quaternion getLookRotation(Vector3 position)` computes a camera-facing orientation.
- `void addSceneUpdateListener(Scene.OnUpdateListener listener)` and `removeSceneUpdateListener(...)` manage per-frame work.
- `void captureScreen(String folderPath, boolean crop, CompleteCallback callback)` captures with PixelCopy.

`SceneViewType` values:

- `BASE`: normal `SceneView`.
- `EXTENSION`: `ExSceneView`, used for a custom/video background.
- `CAMERA`: `CameraSceneView`, used for Camera2 background rendering.
- `VR`: `VrSceneView`, used for sensor-driven 3DoF VR.

### ARSceneLayout

Source: [ARSceneLayout.java](Eq-Renderer/Android/eq-renderer/src/main/java/com/eqgis/eqr/layout/ARSceneLayout.java)

- Extends `SceneLayout` and creates `ArSceneView`.
- `setOnSessionInitializationListener(...)` observes successful session creation.
- `setOnTapPlaneListener(OnTapArPlaneListener)` receives detected plane taps.
- `getSession()`, `getArConfig()`, `getArFrame()` expose AR state.
- `setPlaneRendererEnabled(boolean)`, `isPlaneRendererEnabled()` control plane visualization.
- `getTrackingState()` returns the current AR camera tracking state.
- `resume()` checks camera permission and AR service availability, creates/configures the AR session, and resumes the AR camera.
- `pause()` pauses the session; `destroy()` closes the session and destroys plane helpers before the base scene.
- The current implementation requires an `Activity` context during session creation.
- The app must request `android.permission.CAMERA` and handle unsupported/missing AR services.

### MirrorSceneLayout

Source: [MirrorSceneLayout.java](Eq-Renderer/Android/eq-renderer/src/main/java/com/eqgis/eqr/layout/MirrorSceneLayout.java)

- Provides left/right `FrameLayout` containers for mirrored or stereoscopic display.
- Lifecycle methods are `onResume()`, `onPause()`, and `onDestroy()`.
- `make3DEffect(float offsetPixel)` applies the left/right view offset.
- `getLeftLayout()`, `getRightLayout()`, and `getViewOffset()` expose display state.

## Geometry and renderable APIs

### GeometryUtils

Source: [GeometryUtils.java](Eq-Renderer/Android/eq-renderer/src/main/java/com/eqgis/eqr/geometry/GeometryUtils.java)

Procedural shapes:

- `makeCylinder(float radius, float height, Vector3 center, Material material)`.
- `makeCube(Vector3 size, Vector3 center, Material material)`.
- `makeSphere(float radius, Vector3 center, Material material)`.
- `makeInnerSphere(float radius, Vector3 center, Material material)` creates inward-facing geometry for panoramas.
- `makePlane(Vector3 size, Vector3 center, Material material)` creates an XZ plane with upward normal.
- `makeQuad(Vector3 size, Vector3 center, Material material)` creates a vertical XY quad. `size.x` is width, `size.y` is height, `size.z` is ignored, normal is `Vector3.back()`/positive Z, and UV is not flipped.

Primitive builders accept only spatial `Vector3` positions plus a compatible material:

- `makePoints(List<Vector3>, Material)` uses `POINTS`; at least one position.
- `makeLines(List<Vector3>, Material)` consumes independent point pairs; position count must be even.
- `makeLineStrip(List<Vector3>, Material)` connects consecutive points.
- `makeTriangles(List<Vector3>, Material)` consumes independent triples; count must be a multiple of three.
- `makeTriangleStrip(List<Vector3>, Material)` consumes at least three positions.

The line helpers expand each line segment into triangles and populate `CUSTOM0` vertex data for screen-space width. Do not use a generic colored material for `makeLines`/`makeLineStrip`; create the material with `MaterialFactory.makeLinesWithColor`.

### Primitive material example

```java
List<Vector3> positions = Arrays.asList(
        new Vector3(-1.0f, 0.0f, -3.0f),
        new Vector3(0.0f, 1.0f, -3.0f),
        new Vector3(1.0f, 0.0f, -3.0f));

MaterialFactory.makeLinesWithColor(context, new Color(0.0f, 0.48f, 1.0f), 8.0f)
        .thenAccept(material -> {
            ModelRenderable renderable = GeometryUtils.makeLineStrip(positions, material);
            Node node = new Node();
            node.setRenderable(renderable);
            node.setParent(sceneLayout.getRootNode());
        });
```

Runtime material parameters:

- Point size: `material.setFloat(MaterialFactory.VERTEX_POINT_SIZE, pixels)`.
- Wide-line width: `material.setFloat(MaterialFactory.LINE_WIDTH, pixels)`.
- PBR color: `MaterialFactory.MATERIAL_COLOR`.
- PBR parameters: `MATERIAL_METALLIC`, `MATERIAL_ROUGHNESS`, `MATERIAL_REFLECTANCE`.

### RenderableDefinition and SubGeometry

Source: [RenderableDefinition.java](Eq-Renderer/Android/eq-renderer/src/main/java/com/google/sceneform/rendering/RenderableDefinition.java)

```java
RenderableDefinition.SubGeometry subGeometry =
        RenderableDefinition.SubGeometry.builder()
                .setTriangleIndices(indices)
                .setMaterial(material)
                .build();

RenderableDefinition definition = RenderableDefinition.builder()
        .setVertices(vertices)
        .setSubGeometries(Collections.singletonList(subGeometry))
        .setPrimitiveType(RenderableManager.PrimitiveType.TRIANGLES)
        .build();
```

- Prefer `SubGeometry`, `setSubGeometries`, and `getSubGeometries`.
- `Submesh`, `setSubmeshes`, and `getSubmeshes` remain only as deprecated compatibility APIs.
- `RenderableInstance.changePrimitive(PrimitiveType)` changes the active primitive topology.
- `ModelRenderable.updateFromDefinition(RenderableDefinition)` updates a dynamic renderable.
- `ShapeFactory` is deprecated; use `GeometryUtils`.

### Dynamic Mesh and Line3D

Sources:

- [MeshUtils.java](Eq-Renderer/Android/eq-renderer/src/main/java/com/eqgis/eqr/utils/MeshUtils.java)
- [Line3D.java](Eq-Renderer/Android/eq-renderer/src/main/java/com/eqgis/eqr/geometry/Line3D.java)
- [Line3DPipePointMode.java](Eq-Renderer/Android/eq-renderer/src/main/java/com/eqgis/eqr/geometry/Line3DPipePointMode.java)

`MeshUtils.makeRenderableByCustomMesh(material, vertices, triangleIndices)` creates a custom Mesh. For repeated updates, reuse the Node, Material, and `RenderableDefinition`; update vertices and call `ModelRenderable.updateFromDefinition` rather than rebuilding every frame.

`Line3D` is a Node that expands a path into a pipe Mesh:

- `setMaterial(Material)`, `setRadius(float)`, `setEdgeNum(int)`, `setTextureMode(int)` configure the pipe.
- `setPipePointMode(Line3DPipePointMode)` accepts `ORIGINAL` or `SIN_RESAMPLE`.
- `addPoint(...)` or `setPointList(ArrayList<Vector3>)` changes the path.
- `refresh()` builds or updates the Mesh.
- `dispose()` releases the owned renderable and internal state; call it before dropping the final reference.

## Model and data loading

### GLTF/GLB

Reference: [GltfSampleScene.java](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/scene/GltfSampleScene.java)

```java
ModelRenderable.builder()
        .setSource(context, Uri.parse("gltf/Fox.glb"))
        .setIsFilamentGltf(true)
        .build()
        .thenAccept(renderable -> {
            if (!isSceneActive()) {
                return;
            }
            Node node = new Node();
            node.setRenderable(renderable);
            node.setLocalScale(Vector3.one().scaled(ScaleTool.calculateUnitsScale(renderable)));
            node.setParent(sceneLayout.getRootNode());
        });
```

- GLTF 2.0 `.gltf`/`.glb` is loaded through Filament `gltfio`.
- `ScaleTool.calculateUnitsScale(renderable)` normalizes a model to unit scale.
- Builder overload `setSource(context, uri, cache)` controls registry caching.
- `setAsyncLoadEnabled(boolean)` selects asynchronous or synchronous resource loading.
- Stop model animation and clear `Node.setRenderable(null)` before detaching a GLTF node.
- GLTF materials/resource loaders are shared; never globally destroy them during a Fragment switch.

### PLY and 3D Gaussian Splatting

Reference: [PlyDataScene.java](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/scene/PlyDataScene.java)

```java
ModelRenderable.builder()
        .setSource(context, Uri.parse("ply/sofa.ply"))
        .setDataFormat(Renderable.RenderableDataFormat.PLY)
        .build()
        .thenAccept(renderable -> {
            Node node = new Node();
            node.setRenderable(renderable);
            node.setParent(sceneLayout.getRootNode());
        });
```

- `PlyLoader.createAssets(byte[])` loads conventional PLY data; `destroyPlyAsset()` releases its native asset.
- `PlyGS3dLoader.createAssets(byte[])` loads 3D Gaussian Splatting PLY data; `destroyPlyAsset()` releases its native asset.
- `JPlyAsset` and `JPlyGS3dAsset` contain loader output consumed by renderable internals.
- `GaussianSorter`/`SorterNative` sort splats for view-dependent alpha rendering.

## Material, light, skybox, and camera APIs

### MaterialFactory

Source: [MaterialFactory.java](Eq-Renderer/Android/eq-renderer/src/main/java/com/google/sceneform/rendering/MaterialFactory.java)

- `makeOpaqueWithColor(Context, Color)` and `makeTransparentWithColor(Context, Color)` create standard PBR color materials.
- `makeOpaqueWithTexture(...)` and `makeTransparentWithTexture(...)` create texture materials.
- `makePointsWithColor(Context, Color, float pointSize)` creates the point primitive material.
- `makeLinesWithColor(Context, Color, float lineWidth)` creates the screen-space wide-line material.
- Use `Material.builder().setSource(context, R.raw.some_filamat).build()` for a custom compiled Filament material.
- Use `material.makeCopy()` when separate renderable instances need independently bound parameters or external textures.

### Lighting and camera

- Build lights with `Light.builder(Light.Type.DIRECTIONAL|POINT|SPOTLIGHT)` and attach them using `Node.setLight`.
- Shadow source: `Light.Builder.setShadowCastingEnabled(true)`.
- Renderable controls: `setShadowCaster(boolean)` and `setShadowReceiver(boolean)`.
- Camera projection: `setVerticalFovDegrees(float)`, `setNearClipPlane(float)`, `setFarClipPlane(float)`.
- IBL: `SceneLayout.addIndirectLight(...)` or `setIndirectLight(...)`.
- Skybox: `SceneLayout.setSkybox("enviroments/pillars_2k_skybox.ktx")`.

## Android View rendering in 3D

Reference: [BaseAndroidViewLessonFragment.java](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/tutorial/BaseAndroidViewLessonFragment.java)

```java
ViewRenderable.builder()
        .setView(context, androidView) // Or setView(context, R.layout.some_layout)
        .setVerticalAlignment(ViewRenderable.VerticalAlignment.BOTTOM)
        .setHorizontalAlignment(ViewRenderable.HorizontalAlignment.CENTER)
        .build()
        .thenAccept(viewRenderable -> {
            if (!isSceneActive()) {
                return;
            }
            Node node = new Node();
            node.setRenderable(viewRenderable);
            node.setWorldScale(Vector3.one().scaled(0.25f));
            node.setWorldPosition(position);
            node.setWorldRotation(rotation);
            node.setParent(sceneLayout.getRootNode());
        });
```

- Sceneform's default ViewRenderable scale is approximately 250 dp per world meter.
- A `ScrollView` must have a constrained rendered height; otherwise Android measures and displays all child content instead of scrolling.
- ViewRenderable touch dispatch coexists with camera gestures because `CameraGestureController` does not consume touch events and blocks single-finger rotation when a ViewRenderable is hit.
- Before scene destruction, set ViewRenderable nodes' renderables to null, detach nodes, and release WebView-specific resources/listeners.

## Gesture and interaction APIs

### CameraGestureController

Source: [CameraGestureController.java](Eq-Renderer/Android/eq-renderer/src/main/java/com/eqgis/eqr/gesture/CameraGestureController.java)

```java
CameraGestureController controller =
        new CameraGestureController(sceneLayout.getCamera())
                .setRotationSensitivity(0.16f)
                .setTranslationSensitivity(0.003f)
                .setZoomSensitivity(0.006f)
                .setPitchLimit(85.0f)
                .attachTo(sceneLayout.getSceneView());
```

- One finger rotates the camera.
- Two-finger focus movement translates the camera in its view plane.
- Pinch span changes move the camera forward/back along its view direction.
- `setEnabled`, `isEnabled`, `resetCamera`, and `detach` manage state.
- Always call `detach()` before the touch view is destroyed.
- The listener returns false so scene nodes and Android View controls can still receive touches.

### NodeGestureController

Source: [NodeGestureController.java](Eq-Renderer/Android/eq-renderer/src/main/java/com/eqgis/eqr/gesture/NodeGestureController.java)

```java
NodeGestureController gestures = NodeGestureController.getInstance()
        .setCamera(sceneLayout.getCamera())
        .init(context)
        .setEnabled(true);

float centerDistance = Vector3.subtract(
        node.getWorldPosition(), sceneLayout.getCamera().getWorldPosition()).length();
gestures.select(node, centerDistance);
sceneLayout.getSceneView().getScene()
        .addOnPeekTouchListener((hit, event) -> gestures.onTouch(event));
```

- Select one node with `select(Node, distance)`; call `unSelect()` on cleanup.
- The distance must be camera-to-node-center distance, not the hit surface distance, otherwise translation can jump toward the camera.
- `setFling(boolean)` toggles inertial rotation; `resetNode()` restores the selected node.
- Do not simultaneously enable default camera gestures on a node-gesture lesson. `NodeGestureLessonFragment` overrides the default camera-gesture binding.

### Tap, ray, and collision interaction

```java
node.setOnTapListener((hitTestResult, motionEvent) -> {
    Vector3 hitPoint = hitTestResult.getPoint();
    float distance = hitTestResult.getDistance();
});
```

- `Node.setOnTapListener` is the preferred per-node selection callback.
- `Scene.hitTest(MotionEvent)`/`Scene.hitTest(Ray)` return the nearest `HitTestResult` based on Renderable collision shapes.
- `Scene.addOnPeekTouchListener` observes scene touches before normal dispatch; always remove it on destruction.
- `ViewRenderable`/ViewNode picking maps a scene ray to Android View coordinates, allowing `Button`, `Switch`, `CheckBox`, and scroll gestures to work.

## Animation APIs

Sources: `Eq-Renderer/Android/eq-renderer/src/main/java/com/eqgis/eqr/animation`.

Shared lifecycle on `ARAnimation`: `play()`, `pause()`, `resume()`, `stop()`, `getObjectAnimator()`, and `setARAnimatorListener(...)`.

`ARAnimationParameter` supports:

- Duration, repeat count, repeat mode, and start delay.
- Rotation axis and clockwise direction.
- Start/end `Vector3` for translation.
- Start/end `Location` where geographic values are required.
- Bézier/path waypoints through `addWayPoint`, `getWayPoints`, and `clearWayPoints`.

Repeat constants: `ARAnimationRepeatMode.INFINITE`, `RESTART`, and `REVERSE`.

Animation types:

- `ARAnimationModel(Node)`: plays embedded GLTF clips; select with `setCurrentIndex(int)` and query original clip duration with `getSourceDurationMillis()`.
- `ARAnimationRotation(Node)`: animates local quaternion rotation; configure start/rotation angle and axis.
- `ARAnimationTranslation(Node)`: interpolates local position between start and end vectors.
- `ARAnimationPath(Node)`: moves local position through Bézier waypoints.

Model animation pattern used by the tutorial:

```java
ARAnimationParameter parameter = new ARAnimationParameter();
parameter.setDuration(6000L);
parameter.setRepeatCount(ObjectAnimator.INFINITE);
parameter.setRepeatMode(ARAnimationRepeatMode.RESTART);

ARAnimationModel animation = new ARAnimationModel(modelNode);
animation.setCurrentIndex(animationIndex);
animation.createAnimation(parameter);

long sourceDuration = animation.getSourceDurationMillis();
animation.getObjectAnimator().setDuration(
        useSourceDuration && sourceDuration > 0 ? sourceDuration : customDuration);
animation.play();
```

Create a fresh `ARAnimationModel`/ObjectAnimator when switching a GLTF animation index. Stop and untrack all animators before clearing the model renderable.

## Video, camera, and ExternalTexture

Primary references:

- [BaseVideoLessonFragment.java](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/tutorial/BaseVideoLessonFragment.java)
- [VideoBackgroundLessonFragment.java](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/tutorial/VideoBackgroundLessonFragment.java)
- [VideoTextureLessonFragment.java](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/tutorial/VideoTextureLessonFragment.java)
- [PanoramaVideoLessonFragment.java](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/tutorial/PanoramaVideoLessonFragment.java)
- [CameraStreamLessonFragment.java](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/tutorial/CameraStreamLessonFragment.java)

Video texture sequence:

1. Create and retain `ExternalTexture` before starting asynchronous material loading.
2. Bind `MediaPlayer` output to `new Surface(externalTexture.getSurfaceTexture())`.
3. Wait until the player is prepared and material loading has completed.
4. Bind `material.setExternalTexture("videoTexture", texture)` only when the material is about to be attached to a live renderable.
5. Use a separate material instance/copy for each independently attached Cube, Quad, or inner sphere.
6. On pause, pause playback.
7. On destruction, unbind UI/listeners, call `player.setSurface(null)`, release the player, clear renderables and parents from all video nodes, then drop the ExternalTexture reference.

Never release or invalidate an ExternalTexture while it is still bound to a MaterialInstance used by a Renderable. Filament aborts with `Invalid texture still bound to MaterialInstance` when this order is violated.

Geometry choices:

- `GeometryUtils.makeQuad` for a correctly oriented vertical 2D video surface.
- `GeometryUtils.makeCube` for video on a 3D object.
- `GeometryUtils.makeInnerSphere` for 360° video viewed from inside the sphere.
- `SceneViewType.EXTENSION` for 2D scene backgrounds.
- `SceneViewType.CAMERA` for Camera2 live background rendering.
- `SceneViewType.VR` for sensor-driven 3DoF VR.

Bundled video material: `com.eqgis.eqr.R.raw.external_chroma_key_video_material`. Expected parameters include `videoTexture` and `keyColor`.

## Screen coordinates, rays, measurement, and capture

### ScreenPointTool

Source: [ScreenPointTool.java](Eq-Renderer/Android/eq-renderer/src/main/java/com/eqgis/eqr/utils/ScreenPointTool.java)

- `convertToPixel(Camera, List<Vector3>)` converts world points to screen pixels.
- `convertToScreenPoint(Context, Camera, Vector3)` returns one screen point.
- `generateBounds(...)` produces screen bounds from 3D vertices.
- `screenPointToRay(Context, Camera, int x, int y)` creates a camera ray.
- Screen density and size helpers expose dp, dpi, and pixel dimensions.
- `Camera.worldToScreenPoint(Vector3)` performs reverse projection.

Measurement chain used by the tutorial:

```text
screen pixel (x, y)
  -> ScreenPointTool.screenPointToRay
  -> Scene.hitTest / HitTestResult.getPoint
  -> world-space point
  -> Vector3 distance or Line3D visualization
  -> Camera.worldToScreenPoint for reverse projection
```

### Scene capture

`SceneLayout.captureScreen(outputDirectory, crop, CompleteCallback)` uses PixelCopy. The tutorial writes JPEG to app cache and shares it through FileProvider, so broad external-storage permission is unnecessary.

## Secondary EQR APIs

- `CoordinateUtils` and Native coordinate helpers: coordinate system conversion.
- `PoseUtils`: pose/Euler/quaternion helpers.
- `PolygonUtils`: polygon calculations.
- `Bounds`: ViewRenderable/spatial bounds utilities.
- `BitmapUtils`: bitmap conversion and processing helpers.
- `PresetUtils`: preset rendering helpers; inspect deprecations before new use.
- `SerializeUtils`, `XmlNode`, `XmlNodeParser`: serialization/XML utilities.
- `ImageScanner`, `ImageDB`, `ARImageTrackListener`: AR image database scanning/tracking.
- `ARCoreApkInstaller`: ARCore service installation/readiness helper.
- `Location`: three-component longitude/latitude/height value object used by animation parameters.
- `ResourceConfig`: shared renderer resource configuration, currently including `planeTextureId`.

## Tutorial source index

The developer tutorial has 8 topics and 44 lesson Fragments. Each lesson has its own Fragment. Tab navigation replaces/destroys the previous Fragment instead of only hiding it.

### 1. 基础几何与 Mesh / Basic Geometry and Mesh

- [PrimitiveLessonFragment](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/tutorial/PrimitiveLessonFragment.java): POINTS, LINES, LINE_STRIP, TRIANGLES, TRIANGLE_STRIP, point size, and screen-space line width.
- [TriangleLessonFragment](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/tutorial/TriangleLessonFragment.java): minimal Vertex/index/SubGeometry/RenderableDefinition pipeline.
- [PlaneLessonFragment](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/tutorial/PlaneLessonFragment.java): plane geometry, material, and node attachment.
- [CubeLessonFragment](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/tutorial/CubeLessonFragment.java): `GeometryUtils.makeCube`.
- [GltfLessonFragment](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/tutorial/GltfLessonFragment.java): GLTF/GLB loading through `GltfSampleScene`.
- [PlyLessonFragment](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/tutorial/PlyLessonFragment.java): PLY point cloud/Mesh loading through `PlyDataScene`.

### 2. Android View 渲染到 3D / Android View Rendering in 3D

- [AndroidTextViewLessonFragment](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/tutorial/AndroidTextViewLessonFragment.java): multiple TextView labels in world space.
- [AndroidImageViewLessonFragment](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/tutorial/AndroidImageViewLessonFragment.java): Drawable/ImageView rendering.
- [AndroidWebViewLessonFragment](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/tutorial/AndroidWebViewLessonFragment.java): local HTML WebView cards and WebView cleanup.
- [AndroidWidgetLessonFragment](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/tutorial/AndroidWidgetLessonFragment.java): Button, Switch, CheckBox, and ProgressBar.
- [AndroidLayoutLessonFragment](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/tutorial/AndroidLayoutLessonFragment.java): full XML Layout and constrained ScrollView in 3D.

### 3. 材质、光照与相机 / Materials, Lighting, and Camera

- [MaterialPropertiesLessonFragment](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/tutorial/MaterialPropertiesLessonFragment.java): color, alpha, metallic, roughness, and reflectance.
- [LightTypesLessonFragment](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/tutorial/LightTypesLessonFragment.java): directional, point, and spotlight setup.
- [IblLessonFragment](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/tutorial/IblLessonFragment.java): indirect-light intensity and PBR reflections.
- [SkyboxLessonFragment](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/tutorial/SkyboxLessonFragment.java): KTX skybox plus matching IBL.
- [CameraFovLessonFragment](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/tutorial/CameraFovLessonFragment.java): vertical FOV changes.
- [CameraClipLessonFragment](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/tutorial/CameraClipLessonFragment.java): independent near/far clip SeekBars.
- [ShadowLessonFragment](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/tutorial/ShadowLessonFragment.java): shadow-casting light, caster, and receiver.

### 4. 动画篇 / Animation

- [AnimationOverviewLessonFragment](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/tutorial/AnimationOverviewLessonFragment.java): GLTF, rotation, translation, and path animation in one scene.
- [ModelAnimationLessonFragment](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/tutorial/ModelAnimationLessonFragment.java): GLTF animation index switching and source/custom duration modes.
- [RotationAnimationLessonFragment](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/tutorial/RotationAnimationLessonFragment.java): axis, angle, direction, and duration.
- [TranslationAnimationLessonFragment](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/tutorial/TranslationAnimationLessonFragment.java): start/end Vector3 interpolation and reverse mode.
- [PathAnimationLessonFragment](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/tutorial/PathAnimationLessonFragment.java): Bézier waypoints and path animation.

### 5. 交互篇 / Interaction

- [CameraGestureLessonFragment](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/tutorial/CameraGestureLessonFragment.java): camera rotate, pan, and pinch forward/back with skybox.
- [NodeGestureLessonFragment](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/tutorial/NodeGestureLessonFragment.java): selected-node gesture ownership with camera gestures disabled.
- [CollisionClickLessonFragment](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/tutorial/CollisionClickLessonFragment.java): tap hit world point and distance.
- [ViewPickingLessonFragment](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/tutorial/ViewPickingLessonFragment.java): ray-picked Android View controls and scrollable layout.
- [NodePickingLessonFragment](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/tutorial/NodePickingLessonFragment.java): multiple Cube nodes, ray hit-test, and material color change.

### 6. 视频、相机与外部纹理 / Video, Camera, and External Textures

- [VideoBackgroundLessonFragment](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/tutorial/VideoBackgroundLessonFragment.java): 2D video background and playback timeline.
- [VideoTextureLessonFragment](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/tutorial/VideoTextureLessonFragment.java): one video stream mapped to Cube and Quad using separate MaterialInstances.
- [PanoramaVideoLessonFragment](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/tutorial/PanoramaVideoLessonFragment.java): 360° video on an inner sphere.
- [CameraStreamLessonFragment](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/tutorial/CameraStreamLessonFragment.java): Camera2 live background plus 3D decorations.

### 7. XR 篇 / XR

- [ArEngineLessonFragment](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/tutorial/ArEngineLessonFragment.java): ARCore/AREngine support detection, 6DoF AR, and Camera2 3DoF fallback.
- [ArPlaneDetectionLessonFragment](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/tutorial/ArPlaneDetectionLessonFragment.java): detected horizontal plane tap, anchor creation, and model placement; no 3DoF fallback.
- [ArThreeDofLessonFragment](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/tutorial/ArThreeDofLessonFragment.java): Camera2 background and orientation-sensor rotation tracking.
- [VrThreeDofLessonFragment](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/tutorial/VrThreeDofLessonFragment.java): VrSceneView, orientation sensor, and skybox.
- [OrbSlam3LessonFragment](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/tutorial/OrbSlam3LessonFragment.java): documentation-only GPL boundary and GPL branch integration links.

### 8. 进阶专题 / Advanced Topics

- [ResourceLifecycleLessonFragment](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/tutorial/ResourceLifecycleLessonFragment.java): Node, Renderable, SceneLayout, and global Filament cleanup order.
- [AsyncResourceCacheLessonFragment](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/tutorial/AsyncResourceCacheLessonFragment.java): async/sync GLB loading, registry cache, and late callback invalidation.
- [RenderPerformanceLessonFragment](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/tutorial/RenderPerformanceLessonFragment.java): FPS, object count, Java heap, shadows, debug mode, and instance multipliers.
- [CustomFilamentMaterialLessonFragment](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/tutorial/CustomFilamentMaterialLessonFragment.java): load `.filamat` and edit color/metallic/roughness/reflectance.
- [DynamicMeshLineLessonFragment](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/tutorial/DynamicMeshLineLessonFragment.java): animated custom vertices/indices, `updateFromDefinition`, and `Line3D.refresh/dispose`.
- [SceneCaptureExportLessonFragment](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/tutorial/SceneCaptureExportLessonFragment.java): PixelCopy capture, app cache, JPEG, and FileProvider sharing.
- [ScreenRayMeasureLessonFragment](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/fragments/tutorial/ScreenRayMeasureLessonFragment.java): screen ray, collision world point, reverse projection, Line3D, and two-point distance.

## Common sample source index

- [BaseSceneActivity](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/samples/BaseSceneActivity.java): normal 3D scene, GLTF, IBL, camera, and node gestures.
- [PlyDataSceneActivity](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/samples/PlyDataSceneActivity.java): PLY and 3DGS data rendering.
- [InteractiveActivity](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/samples/InteractiveActivity.java): node taps, ViewRenderable labels, and touch interaction.
- [VideoActivity](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/samples/VideoActivity.java): ExternalTexture video background.
- [ARSceneActivity](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/samples/ARSceneActivity.java): AR 3D scene.
- [ARScenePlaneActivity](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/samples/ARScenePlaneActivity.java): plane detection, anchors, and GLTF placement.
- [CameraActivity](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/samples/CameraActivity.java): Camera2 scene background and capture-related behavior.
- [VRSceneActivity](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/samples/VRSceneActivity.java): virtual scene and device orientation.
- [VRScene360Activity](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/samples/VRScene360Activity.java): 360° video and ExternalTexture.
- [EarthActivity](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/samples/EarthActivity.java): textured sphere and camera interaction.
- [CoordinateConvertActivity](SampleProj/app/src/main/java/com/eqgis/test/samples/CoordinateConvertActivity.java): screen/world/model coordinate conversion.

## Assets and material tooling

Library assets:

- `Eq-Renderer/Android/eq-renderer/src/main/assets/enviroments/light/lightroom_ibl.ktx`.
- `Eq-Renderer/Android/eq-renderer/src/main/assets/enviroments/pillars_2k_skybox.ktx`.
- Compiled renderer materials are in `Eq-Renderer/Android/eq-renderer/src/main/res/raw`.

Important compiled materials:

- `sceneform_primitive_point.filamat`.
- `sceneform_primitive_line.filamat`.
- `external_chroma_key_video_material.filamat`.
- `camera_stream_base.filamat` and `camera_stream_depth.filamat`.
- `sceneform_ply_base_material.filamat`.
- `sceneform_gaussian_splat.filamat`, `sceneform_gaussian_splat_alpha.filamat`, and `sceneform_gaussian_dot.filamat`.
- Standard opaque, transparent, textured, plane, shadow, and ViewRenderable materials.

Material sources live in `Tool/assets/mat`. After changing a `.mat`, use `Tool/genfilamat-mobile.bat`/`matc.exe` and update the matching library `res/raw` output. Point materials use `gl_PointSize`; wide lines are implemented by geometry expansion and a `CUSTOM0` vertex attribute rather than `GLES30.glLineWidth`.

Sample assets:

- GLB: `bee.glb`, `Fox.glb`, `DamagedHelmet.glb`, `cube.glb`, `csys.glb`, `table.glb`.
- PLY: `sofa.ply`, `test_sh_0.ply`.
- Video: `assets/video/eq_test_video.mp4` and `res/raw/vr_video_city.mp4`.

Large assets affect APK size and memory. Prefer streaming/asynchronous loading, reuse registry-cached renderables when appropriate, and keep temporary/export files in app cache.

## API migration and correctness rules

- Prefer `GeometryUtils`; `com.google.sceneform.rendering.ShapeFactory` is deprecated.
- Prefer `RenderableDefinition.SubGeometry`; `Submesh` and `set/getSubmeshes` are deprecated compatibility APIs.
- `Line3D.setPipePointMode` uses `Line3DPipePointMode`, not an integer.
- Use `MaterialFactory.makePointsWithColor` for points and `makeLinesWithColor` for line helpers.
- `makeQuad` is vertical and positive-Z-facing; `makePlane` is horizontal and upward-facing.
- Use `makeInnerSphere`, not a normal sphere, for inside-view panorama rendering.
- A GLTF animation index is valid only when `node.getRenderableInstance()` exists and `getAnimationCount() > index`.
- Animation availability depends on the model. A model can report clips whose source data behaves incorrectly; verify with a known-good GLB such as `Fox.glb`.
- When changing model animation index, create a new `ARAnimationModel`/ObjectAnimator and reset progress.
- Use `getSourceDurationMillis()` only after the model animation has been created for a valid index; duration mode selection remains application logic.
- Disable default camera gestures on pages that give the same gesture stream to `NodeGestureController`.
- For node translation, calculate depth from camera to node center, not from camera to hit surface.
- Remove all scene update, peek-touch, sensor, camera, media, and animation listeners before destroying their host.
- Release scene-owned renderables by clearing Node references first. Do not directly destroy a shared MaterialInstance that is still referenced by another Renderable.
- ExternalTexture teardown order is mandatory: detach listeners/timeline, detach player Surface, release player, clear renderables/nodes, then release/drop texture state.
- AR pages must distinguish unsupported hardware, missing AR service, denied camera permission, and session/camera failure. Only pages that do not require plane tracking can fall back to Camera2 3DoF.
- Main branch documentation may link to ORB-SLAM3, but GPL eq-slam code must not be copied into the Apache-2.0 main branch.

## Guidance for coding agents

- For a normal 3D feature, start from `BaseTutorialFragment` or `BaseSceneActivity` and use `SceneLayout`.
- For tutorial lifecycle behavior, start from `BaseSampleFragment`; do not invent a parallel cleanup order.
- For GLTF, start from `GltfSampleScene` and add late-callback guards.
- For PLY/3DGS, start from `PlyDataScene` and inspect the corresponding native loader before changing data layout.
- For Android UI in 3D, start from `BaseAndroidViewLessonFragment`.
- For material/light/camera controls, start from `BaseMaterialCameraLessonFragment` and its seven lessons.
- For animation, start from `BaseAnimationLessonFragment` and create fresh animators when parameters/indexes change.
- For node/camera gestures, use the existing controllers and explicitly choose which controller owns the touch stream.
- For video/external texture, start from `BaseVideoLessonFragment`; cleanup order is safety-critical.
- For AR/XR, start from `BaseXrSceneLessonFragment` and `XrCapabilityStatus`; capability messaging and fallback rules are already centralized.
- For dynamic resources/performance/capture/rays, start from `BaseAdvancedLessonFragment` and the relevant advanced lesson.
- Before modifying Sceneform/Filament internals, trace creation, scene attachment, pause/resume, node detachment, renderable/material disposal, SceneView destruction, and final Engine cleanup.
- Prefer minimal, Java-8-compatible changes. Keep public API changes backward-compatible when possible and mark old APIs deprecated with their replacement.
